description: Test jsonb_each_text in select-list position: still an anonymous (key, value) record, not text, even though both fields are text-typed

columns.name: kv
columns.note: jsonb_each_text in select-list position yields an anonymous (key, value) record; the neutral type vocabulary cannot name it, so unknown rather than string

name: jsonb_each_text_select_list
query_sql:
-- @name GetDocEntryText
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, jsonb_each_text(data) AS kv FROM documents
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE documents (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, data JSONB NOT NULL, metadata JSONB);
